name: pull-requests
description: Open pull requests from GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps in a pane beside the chat: the session's own repos first, then yours elsewhere, each with its checks, review and draft state, a Review button that asks Claude to review it, and Log in for a service that needs it

gitlabHosts.title: GitLab hosts
gitlabHosts.description: Comma-separated GitLab hosts to ask (each needs glab auth login). Only these are asked, never a host a repo's remote names on its own

azureProjects.title: Azure DevOps projects
azureProjects.description: Comma-separated org/project pairs to ask for your pull requests, on top of az's default project and those your repos are in

refreshMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
refreshMinutes.description: How often the pane asks GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps again
